Advanced Research Facilities
The university provides advanced research facilities, access to leading academic resources, and opportunities to collaborate with renowned institutions such as
IBM, Apple, Apollo Hospitals, Hawk Eye Forensic, IEEE, Google, Harvard Business Publishing Education, Lenskart, Aivancity School for Technology, 3SE Experience, Consortium of NLUs, American Heart Association, ALTTC, BSNL, IBM SkillsBuild, IBM Business Analytics Lab, Monash University
and many more.
Students and faculty members are encouraged to engage in impactful research, publish scholarly work, and contribute to innovations that address real-world challenges.
World-Class Infrastructure
Spread across 130+ acres, TMU is equipped with
smart classrooms, cutting-edge laboratories, digital libraries, innovation and research centres, expansive auditoriums, well-furnished hostels, a gymnasium, and extensive sports arenas, including indoor and outdoor stadiums.
TMU's 14 on-campus colleges offer a broad spectrum of academic programs, providing a comprehensive environment where students can thrive in all aspects of their lives.
The university also has a
1000+ bed
multi-speciality hospital
,
offering a wide range of services. It provides comprehensive primary, secondary, and tertiary care, serving as a crucial healthcare resource for the community. The hospital also offers hands-on practical training for medical, nursing, and allied health students, allowing them to gain real-world experience in a professional environment.
Career & Placement Support
The university provides placement assistance through its dedicated Career Guidance and Placement Cell. TMU’s
Corporate Resource Centre
(CRC)
supports students in building successful careers by providing
placement opportunities, internships, industry interactions, recruitment drives, career guidance, and employer connect
. CRC works closely with leading organisations to help students explore suitable career opportunities and transition smoothly from campus to the workplace.
The
Centre for Teaching, Learning & Development
(CTLD)
focuses on developing students’
employability and professional skills
. Through
aptitude training, communication and soft-skills development, personality development, leadership training, group discussions, and interview preparation
, CTLD helps students become confident, industry-ready professionals.
Industry Connections
TMU has over 100 collaborations with leading national and international organisations, research institutions, and corporate partners to provide students with valuable exposure through internships, live projects, industrial visits, expert lectures, workshops, and placement opportunities.
Notable Alumni Network
With over 32,000 alumni, TMU has built a strong network of graduates contributing across diverse fields in India and abroad. Alumni contribute to industry, research, entrepreneurship, and public service while maintaining connections with the university through mentorship, guest lectures, networking events, and career guidance initiatives for current students.

Examination Overview
Welcome to the
Examination Cell
Exams test your memory, life tests your learning; others will test
your patience.
To be eligible to appear in the end semester/annual examination a
student should have a minimum of 75% attendance in the semester classes.
The examination system is based on a continuous evaluation of the students performance
on different parameters. Most of the programmes of the University are based on semester system
except wherever the University authorities and statutory bodies decide otherwise. The continuous
evaluation is both internal and external. While the internal evaluation comprises of two internal
mid semester examinations, projects, assignments, tutorials and attendance, the end semester
examination is fully external for ensuring fair assessment of the students competence.
A student is eligible for the award of University degree if he/she has undergone the
regular course of studies, completed the project report/dissertation specified in the course
curriculum within the stipulated time and have secured the minimum credits and percentage of marks
needed for the award of concerned degree as per the University ordinances. For details relating to
examinations the students are advised to go through the University Ordinance available at University
website.

TMU
Scholarship
At Teerthanker Mahaveer University, we believe that the meritorious
students should be rewarded and should not be left
out of the mainstream in their quest for higher education. Scholarship at the university are
provided to the outstanding students. Thus, to recognize
the talent of meritorious and needy students ,the university has provision of scholarships,
medals, awards and certificates. Regulations governing
these scholarships/awards can be amended from time to time for registering for the same please
follow the guidelines.
Academic
Scholarship
All other scholarships are additional scholarships that are added on
top of the Academic Scholarship.
As a formal rule, a maximum of 3 Scholarship/Concessions can be
availed by a candidate in addition to the Academic Scholarship
(Academic Scholarship + 3 Additional Scholarship/Concessions)
These scholarships are applied in descending order, in order to
provide the maximum benefit to the
candidate.
This concession is only applicable to yearly payment mode and
candidates paying their fees in half-yearly mode will not be
provided any concession.
Scholarship for Jain Students
+

waiver in fee for the Jain students admitted during the academic session 2026-27, and it
shall be applicable for the entire duration of the programme in which the student has taken
admission during the academic session 2026-27:

Submit semester-wise/annual passing mark sheets as proof of academic progression.
Maintain satisfactory academic performance and fulfill all academic requirements prescribed by the University.
Submit relevant sports achievement certificates earned during the current academic year.
3. Disqualification Clauses:
Students shall not be eligible for continuation of the Sports Scholarship in the following cases:
Failure in any semester or academic requirement.
Involvement in disciplinary misconduct or indiscipline.
No Relevant sports achievement certificates earned during the current academic year.

College of
Computing Sciences & IT, among the top colleges for computer science
College of Computing Sciences & IT,
among the top colleges for computer science
The College of Computing Sciences & IT was established in 2014
(formerly
known as the Department of Computer Applications, established in 2001), is a leading private
computing sciences college in UP.
With a strong emphasis on emerging technologies such as
Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML),
and Deep Learning (DL), the college equips students with the in-demand skills to thrive in
the rapidly evolving IT industry.
Beyond technical expertise, the College of Computing Sciences & IT also fosters an
entrepreneurial mindset, nurturing the
next generation of innovators
and visionaries.
In today's digitally driven world, the demand for skilled
professionals in the field of computer sciences is
soaring higher than ever before. Amidst this surge, Teerthanker Mahaveer University's
College of Computing Sciences & IT
(CCSIT) stands out as a beacon of excellence, offering a comprehensive blend of academic
rigor and practical exposure.
Let's delve into why College of Computing Sciences & IT at TMU is not just a college but
a transformative journey for
aspiring IT enthusiasts.
Read More

Key Highlights
Experienced Faculty:
The college boasts a team of highly
qualified faculty members with deep expertise in various computing domains, ensuring that
students receive top-tier academic mentorship.
Industry Linkages:
TMU’s College of Computing Sciences & IT
maintains close ties with the IT industry, ensuring regular guest lectures, industry visits,
and internships that enhance student employability.
Specialization in Emerging Technologies:
The college
offers specialized training in trending fields like Cloud Computing, Blockchain,
Cybersecurity, Data Science, and Internet of Things (IoT), helping students stay ahead
of the curve.
Comprehensive Career Support:
With dedicated placement
cell and career guidance, CCSIT graduates have successfully secured positions in top
multinational companies and startups.
Holistic Development:
Beyond academics, the college
emphasizes soft skills, leadership, and critical thinking, fostering well-rounded
individuals ready to tackle real-world challenges.
Research and Innovation:
CCSIT encourages students to
engage in research projects and innovative developments, promoting a culture of inquiry
and creativity in the field of computing sciences.
Read More
Placement/Internship
As a centre for computing sciences, CCSIT offers a pool of internships and
placement opportunities for a swift transition from academics to the professional world.
Our training & placement cell (CRC) is committed to generating
top-notch placement and training opportunities.
Reputed industrial giants like HCL, Infosys, Wipro, Vivo, TCS, Tech
Mahindra, and more visit our campus for recruitment drives.
With a focus on ensuring 82% placement and securing the best jobs,
our CRC and CTLD departments prepare students from the beginning.

Curriculum
The CCSIT’s curriculum is designed to equip students with updated knowledge and technical
skills. Our faculties use effective pedagogy, fostering an optimal learning environment. We
value students’ participation in conferences, seminars, workshops, and group discussions for
overall development.
We also offer short-term courses to expand their skill set.
Expert guest lectures and collaborations with industry leaders enhance our students'
learning.
Our curriculum aligns with NEP2020, preparing students for success in technology. The
College of
computing sciences & IT is a leading computing science college that ignites the spark of
innovation in every student.
Read More
Infrastructure
CCSIT provides a conducive environment to provide quality education and support to both students
and faculty members. The College boasts
19 well-equipped labs with a total of 950 computers and peripherals,
including a dedicated iMac Lab with 30 Apple Desktop PCs for the Apple Authorized
Training Centre.
Specialised labs such as Cisco Networking Lab, Linux Lab, Advanced
Database Lab, Dot Net Lab, Android Lab, JAVA Lab, and IBM Cloud Software Lab for
Emerging Technologies.
World-class infrastructure featuring spacious lecture halls, a
lecture
theatre, a well-equipped library, and a seminar hall, all equipped with advanced
facilities.
NVIDIA lab to enhance student skills in graphics and visualization.
Spoken Tutorials by IIT-Bombay for assessing and enhancing student
skills.

Why Teerthanker Mahaveer University is the best choice for you
+
UGC-Approved with NAAC-A Accreditation
At TMU's College of
Computing Sciences & IT, quality education is not just a promise but a proven reality.
With UGC approval and NAAC-A accreditation, the college upholds the highest
standards of academic excellence, ensuring that every student receives a world-class education.
Strong Focus on Practical Knowledge
Theory lays the foundation, but practical skills are the building blocks of
success in the IT industry. College of
Computing Sciences & IT places a strong emphasis on hands-on learning, equipping students
with the practical knowledge and skills demanded by today's dynamic IT landscape.
100% Placement Assistance with an Excellent Track Record
For students, the ultimate goal of education is to secure a rewarding career.
At College of
Computing Sciences & IT, we take pride in our track record of providing 100% placement assistance to
our students,
connecting them with leading companies in the industry and kickstarting their professional journey
on the right note.
Strong Industry Connections with Top Companies at College of
Computing Sciences & IT
+
Networking is key in the IT world, and at College of
Computing Sciences & IT, we ensure that our students have access to top-notch
industry connections. Collaborations with giants like IBM, Oracle, CISCO Networking Academy, and i

Organized under an official TED
x
license, TED
x
TMU Moradabad brings together thinkers, innovators, creators, scholars, entrepreneurs, artists, scientists, educators, and changemakers whose ideas have the potential to influence the way we understand our world.

03
TRANSFORMATIVE JOURNEY
Immersive Experience
More than a series of presentations, TED
x
TMU Moradabad is conceived as an immersive experience—one where listening becomes reflection, reflection becomes dialogue, and dialogue becomes the beginning of change.
OUR VISION
“To create a platform where remarkable ideas find their voice, diverse perspectives converge, and meaningful conversations inspire change"
OUR PURPOSE
From Shaping Metal to Shaping Possibilities
In the
Brass City
, we have long known the art of giving form to the raw. Generations of craftspeople in Moradabad have transformed metal through imagination, skill, patience, and precision—creating objects that carry both craftsmanship and character.
TED
x
TMU Moradabad extends that tradition—from shaping metal to shaping possibilities.
We believe that ideas, much like raw material, rarely arrive in their final form. They begin as questions, observations, experiences, discoveries, and dreams. Through conversation, reflection, challenge, and collaboration, they are shaped into possibilities that can influence individuals, communities, and the world around them.
This is the purpose of bringing TED
x
to
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
: to create a space where remarkable ideas can take form and where diverse voices can meet curious minds.
TED
x
TMU Moradabad will bring together thinkers, researchers, entrepreneurs, artists, educators, scientists, innovators, and changemakers whose journeys and perspectives invite us to look beyond the familiar. Some ideas may emerge from laboratories and classrooms; others from businesses, creative spaces, communities, or deeply personal experiences. What unites them is their ability to make us pause, question, and see differently.
For our students
TED
x
TMU Moradabad is an invitation to step beyond the boundaries of a prescribed curriculum and encounter ideas that expand imagination and ambition.
For our faculty and researchers
It is a space where disciplines can intersect and new questions can emerge.
For the wider community
It is an opportunity to place Moradabad's voices, stories, creativity, and aspirations within a larger national and global conversation.
Most importantly, TED
x
TMU Moradabad seeks to create conversations that continue beyond the stage. An idea may become a question in a classroom, a direction for research, the beginning of an enterprise, the seed of a collaboration, or simply a new way of looking at the world.
That is the spirit we hope to cultivate.
From a city that has mastered the art of shaping the raw, we begin a new journey of shaping what could be.

About IQAC
(Internal Quality
Assurance Cell)
The
Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
at Teerthanker Mahaveer
University (TMU) is
committed to continuous quality enhancement in all aspects of higher education.
Established in line with the guidelines of the
National Assessment and Accreditation
Council (NAAC)
, the IQAC functions as a driving force for performance improvement and
institutional excellence.
At TMU, the IQAC plays an important role in promoting quality culture in all
academic and
administrative processes. It acts as a nodal agency for coordinating quality-related activities,
promoting innovative teaching-learning practices, and ensuring the integration of best
practices into institutional functioning. The Cell continually strives to establish quality
benchmarks aligned with national and international ranking and accreditation frameworks,
while also contributing to the formulation of policies that are learner-centric and inclusive in
nature.
The IQAC works to enhance stakeholder engagement, feedback mechanisms, and the
strategic alignment of University activities with its vision and mission and is committed to
nurturing academic excellence, operational efficiency, and a continuous cycle of quality
improvement to achieve the University’s overarching goals of global relevance and societal
impact.
Message from the
Chairperson,
IQAC
TMU-IQAC is committed
to continuous monitoring, innovation, and
stakeholder engagement. We drive measurable improvements aligned
with the University's vision of global relevance. Our efforts focus on
enhancing institutional performance and sustaining excellence. IQAC
remains committed to transformative growth and quality-centric
development.
- Prof. (Dr.) V. K. Jain
Chairperson, IQAC
Message from the
Director,
IQAC
Dedicated to promote a
culture of quality across all academic and
administrative function at TMU. Our focus remains on aligning
institutional practices with national and global benchmarks,
enhancing stakeholder engagement, and to integrate best practices
through inclusive, learner-focused policies. We strive for continuous
improvement supporting University's vision of institutional
excellence and quality education with societal impact.
- Prof. (Dr.) Nishith Kumar Mishra
Director, IQAC

Welcome to
Corporate Resource
Centre
The Corporate Resource Centre (CRC) at Teerthanker Mahaveer University plays
a vital role in preparing students for successful careers. Focused on both personality
development and career readiness, the CRC provides comprehensive guidance on crucial interview
skills, such as body language, communication, and confidence. Through structured programs,
including mock interviews, aptitude training, and soft skill workshops, the CRC ensures students
are well-equipped to face corporate recruitment processes.
The centre works at both the
university and college levels to create tailored programs, helping students develop
technical
knowledge, set career goals, and improve overall employability.
In addition to personal and professional development, the CRC fosters
strong
industry-academia linkages, bringing together students and top corporate entities for
internships and job placements. With over 400 companies participating in the university’s
placement drives, the CRC provides students with ample opportunities to connect with leading
organizations across diverse fields such as engineering, management, healthcare, and more.
By
hosting regular industry visits and interactions with corporate leaders, the CRC ensures
that
students gain practical insights and are well-prepared for the demands of the modern job
market.

TMU is Hiring: Assistant Professor (General Medicine)
+
Job
Description:
The Assistant Professor in General Medicine is responsible for delivering quality patient care, teaching undergraduate and postgraduate medical students, participating in research activities, and contributing to departmental administration. The incumbent shall perform clinical, academic, research and administrative responsibilities in accordance with National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations and institutional policies.
Responsibilities :
Provide comprehensive medical care to patients in OPD, IPD, ICU and Emergency.
Diagnose and manage acute and chronic medical conditions using evidence-based practices.
Conduct daily ward rounds and supervise patient management.
Guide and supervise Senior Residents, Junior Residents and Interns during clinical duties.
Perform and supervise bedside procedures within the scope of General Medicine.
Respond to medical emergencies and ensure timely interventions.
Coordinate patient care with other clinical departments and allied healthcare professionals.
Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation and medical records.
Teach MBBS students, interns and postgraduate residents as per the curriculum.
Conduct lectures, tutorials, bedside clinics, seminars and practical demonstrations.
Prepare teaching plans, lesson schedules and assessment materials.
Evaluate students through internal assessments, practical examinations and viva voce.
Mentor postgraduate students in academics and clinical training.
Participate in curriculum development and academic planning.
Conduct independent and collaborative clinical research.
Publish research papers in peer-reviewed and indexed journals.
Guide postgraduate dissertations and student research projects.
Present research papers and scientific work at conferences, CMEs, and workshops.
Participate in clinical audits and quality improvement initiatives.
Assist the Head of Department in academic and administrative activities.
Participate in departmental meetings, committees, accreditation, and inspection-related work.
Ensure compliance with NMC regulations, NABH standards, and institutional policies.
Maintain departmental records, reports, and statutory documentation.
Participate in community health programmes, health camps, and outreach activities.
Perform duties assigned by the Head of Department and institutional authorities.
Requirements:
MBBS with MD/DNB in General Medicine from a recognized institution.
Registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) / State Medical Council.
Eligibility as per the latest NMC norms for the post of Assistant Professor.
Experience as prescribed by the latest NMC regulations for appointment as Assistant Professor in General Medicine.
Prior teaching and clinical experience in a recognized medical college is desirable.
Commitment to continuous professional development.

Join TMU as University Librarian – Drive Academic Resources & Innovation
+
Job
Description:
The University Librarian is responsible for the overall administration, development and
management of the university library system. The role ensures effective access to academic resources, supports teaching, learning and research activities, and implements modern library practices including digital and automated services.
Responsibilities :
Oversee day-to-day operations of the central and departmental libraries
Develop and implement library policies, rules and procedures
Prepare and manage the library budget
Plan and develop acquisition strategies for books, journals, e-resources and databases
Co-ordinate with academic departments for resource requirements
Ensure proper cataloguing, classification and shelving of materials
Implement and manage Integrated Library Management Systems (ILMS)
Develop and maintain digital library services (e-books, e-journals, institutional repository)
Ensure access to national and international databases
Facilitate access to library resources for students, faculty, and researchers
Conduct user orientation and information literacy programs
Address user queries and provide reference services
Support research activities through literature searches and reference assistance
Promote plagiarism awareness and use of plagiarism detection tools
Assist in indexing, citation, and research impact metrics
Ensure library standards as per UGC, NAAC and other regulatory bodies
Maintain records and documentation for audits and accreditation
Prepare reports and statistics related to library usage
Requirements:
Master’s Degree in Library Science/ Information Science with at least 55% marks
Ph.D. in Library Science/ Information Science
Minimum 12 years of experience in a university/ College Library
At least 05 years of experience in a university setup
Experience in library automation and digital resource management
Prior experience in a leadership/administrative role preferred
Knowledge of library software (e.g., KOHA, SOUL)
Familiarity with digital repositories and research databases

Excellent communication, coordination and drafting skills.

Job
Description:
Teerthanker Mahaveer University invites applications for the faculty positions of Professor/Associate Professor in its College of Pharmacy, specifically in the specialized fields of Pharmaceutics, Pharmacology, Pharmacognosy, and Pharmaceutical Chemistry. Successful candidates will be established scholars and educators who will drive excellence in teaching, research, and institutional development, contributing significantly to the academic growth of the department and the university.
Responsibilities :
Teaching: Deliver engaging and effective lectures, tutorials, and practical laboratory sessions for B.Pharm and M.Pharm students in the respective specialization.

Student Development: Conduct student assessments, evaluate progress, and provide academic counseling and mentorship to students.
Research: Engage in departmental research activities, guide student projects, and contribute to research publications (especially for Assistant Professors).
Administration: Participate actively in internal departmental duties, exam invigilation, committee work, and co-curricular activities as assigned by the Head of the Department or Principal.

Required Qualifications: Must possess a minimum of M.Pharm in the relevant specialization (Pharmaceutics, Pharmacology, Pharmacognosy, or Pharmaceutical Chemistry). A Ph.D. is highly desirable and often required for the Assistant Professor level as per PCI guidelines.
Experience: Relevant teaching and/or research experience in a recognized pharmacy institution is preferred.
Skills: Strong foundational subject knowledge, effective pedagogical skills, proficiency in laboratory techniques, and good communication abilities.
Regulatory Compliance: Qualifications and experience must strictly align with the latest guidelines and standards set by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).

TMU Students Learned Financial Planning and Investment Skills
Admissions Open
Admissions Open

TMU Students Learned Financial Planning and Investment Skills
05-09-2026
Guest-Lecture
Teerthanker Mahaveer University (TMU) organised a financial awareness programme for students at
TMU College of Law and Legal Studies
. The programme was organised under the Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC), TMU, as part of the SEBI Investor’s Awareness Programme.
The session was held on the theme
“Financial Planning & Investment Planning.”
It focused on helping students understand saving, investment, budgeting and financial security. Around 50 students and members of the organising team participated in the programme.
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
Apply for Admission
Apply for Admission
Expert Explained the Basics of Financial Planning
Prof. (Dr.) Asha Ram Tripathi, SEBI-SMART Resource Person and former Dean and Head of the Department of Commerce at Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, was the main speaker.
During the session, Prof. Tripathi explained the six important pillars of personal finance:
income, expenses, budgeting, savings, investment and loans
. He also explained the difference between needs, wants and aspirations.
Students were introduced to the
50-30-20 budgeting rule
. Under this rule, 50% of income was suggested for needs, 30% for wants and 20% for savings and investments.
Students Learned About Investment and Compounding
The speaker also explained the power of
compounding
and the benefits of starting investments at a young age. Practical examples were used to help students understand how small and regular investments could grow over time.
Students also learned about mutual funds, different levels of investment risk and the
Risk-O-Meter
. They were encouraged to select investment options according to their financial goals and risk-taking ability.
Awareness About Financial and Cyber Fraud
The programme also focused on protecting students from financial fraud. Students were made aware of common scams such as
phishing links, vishing calls, lottery scams and card skimming
.
They were advised not to share their passwords or OTPs with anyone. Students were also encouraged to invest only through
SEBI-registered intermediaries
and use trusted resources such as the SEBI Investor website, Saarthi App and NSE website for financial information.
TMU Faculty Members Participated in the Programme
Prof. (Dr.) Harbansh Dixit, Dean, TMCLLS, welcomed the chief speaker by presenting a plant. Prof. (Dr.) Sushil Kumar Singh, Principal, TMCLLS, delivered the welcome address and highlighted the importance of financial knowledge among young students.
The programme was coordinated and conducted by Mr. Suvigya Saxena, Assistant Professor, TMCLLS. At the end of the programme, Prof. (Dr.) Harbansh Dixit delivered the vote of thanks. Prof. (Dr.) Asha Ram Tripathi was honoured with a certificate of appreciation and a memento. E-certificates were also distributed to all participants.
Conclusion
The programme strengthened financial awareness among TMU students by giving them practical knowledge about budgeting, saving, investment and financial safety. The session also encouraged students to make informed financial decisions, develop healthy saving habits and remain alert to financial and cyber fraud.

Khelo India Samvad at TMU Inspired Students to Embrace Sports and Fitness
27-08-2026
Sports
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
celebrated National Sports Day 2026 by organising Khelo India Samvad at the campus. The programme connected students and other participants with Prime Minister Narendra Modi through a live virtual interaction. The event focused on sports, fitness, youth leadership, nation-building, and the vision of a developed India.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi Addressed Young Participants
The programme began with the welcome of guests, lamp lighting, and Saraswati Vandana. A virtual welcome was then presented by My Bharat volunteers. After the screening of a short film based on National Sports Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the participants through a live broadcast from the Prime Minister’s Office.
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
Apply for Admission
Apply for Admission
During his 23-minute address, the Prime Minister remembered Major Dhyan Chand and highlighted the importance of sports in building a strong and confident India. He said that India was committed to developing a modern sports ecosystem.
He also highlighted India’s dream of hosting the 2036 Olympics. He said that India needed to increase its participation in different sports and develop expertise in disciplines where other countries had achieved success.
Students Were Encouraged to Make Sports a Part of Life
The Khelo India Samvad at TMU encouraged students to look at sports beyond winning medals. The Prime Minister said that sports should contribute to the overall development of a person and should help young people become physically fit, mentally strong, and confident.
His message created enthusiasm among the students at TMU. The interaction also encouraged young participants to connect sports with leadership, discipline, fitness, and nation-building.
Local Youth Dialogue Was Also Organised
After the Prime Minister’s virtual interaction, a local discussion was organised with students, youth representatives, and people associated with sports.
MLC Dr Jaypal Singh Vyas guided the students and spoke about the importance of sports in developing physical fitness, mental strength, and emotional stability. He referred to successful sportspersons such as Mahendra Singh Dhoni, Piyush Chawla, and Vaibhav Suryavanshi, who had achieved recognition despite coming from smaller cities.
District Youth Officer Sachin Kumar also interacted with the students. Sports experts shared their experiences and views with the young participants.
Youth Leadership and Nation-Building Were Discussed
Open interaction sessions were also held under Youth Samvad, Viksit Bharat, Youth Leaders Dialogue, and Idea Submission initiatives. Before the conclusion of the programme, students took a pledge against drug abuse.
The programme ended with the distribution of mementoes, a vote of thanks, and the National Anthem. Director Student Welfare Prof. M.P. Singh, Prof. Madhu Mishra, Dr Ravi Prakash Singh, and Mr Deepak Malik played important roles in coordinating the programme. My Bharat volunteer Himanshi Sharma conducted the event.
Conclusion
The Khelo India Samvad at TMU gave students an opportunity to hear the Prime Minister’s message on sports, fitness, and youth participation. The programme encouraged students to adopt sports as an important part of life and contribute to the vision of a healthy, confident, and developed India.

Community-Service
Teerthanker Mahaveer University organised a Blood Donation Campunder the National Blood Donation Campaign. The camp was organised by the National Service Scheme (NSS) unit at the Blood Bank of TMU Hospital. The event was conducted as per the guidelines of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
Faculty Members and Students Participated
Faculty members, students, and NSS volunteers from different colleges of the university participated actively in the blood donation camp. More than 40 faculty members and students had registered for blood donation through a Google Form before the event.
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
Apply for Admission
Apply for Admission
A total of
22 people donated blood
during the camp. The donors included three faculty members, while the remaining donors were students. The event encouraged members of the TMU community to contribute to a meaningful social cause and spread awareness about the importance of blood donation.
Prof. MP Singh Encouraged Blood Donation
Prof. MP Singh attended the programme as the Chief Guest. He encouraged young people to participate actively in blood donation activities. He highlighted that blood donation was a form of life-saving service because donated blood could help patients in need.
The programme was managed under the leadership of NSS Coordinator
Dr. Ravi Prakash Singh
. He had coordinated the registration process and encouraged students and faculty members from different colleges to participate in the campaign.
Dr. Ravi Prakash Singh said that blood donation was not only a social service but also a humanitarian commitment to help people in need. He also appealed to the university community to participate actively in similar public welfare activities in the future.

The medical team included Dr. Ashutosh Kumar, Professor and Blood Centre In-charge; Dr. Shyamoli Dutta, Medical Officer, Blood Centre; Dr. Nikhil, Assistant Professor, Pathology; Dr. Pooja Pandey and Dr. Komal Paswal, Junior Residents; and technical and support staff members.
The team helped ensure that the blood donation process was conducted properly and smoothly throughout the camp.

The Blood Donation Camp at TMU promoted the values of social responsibility, community service, and compassion among students and faculty members. The camp successfully conveyed the message of the National Blood Donation Campaign,
“Donate Blood – Save Lives.”
The event also encouraged the

“Donate Blood, Save Lives – Be a Hero.”

Leadership-Talk-Series
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
(TMU) organised the 21st Leadership Talk Series-cum-Seminar to guide students about civil services preparation and career opportunities. The session focused on practical strategies, goal setting, leadership, ethics, and personal development. The event gave students an opportunity to learn from experienced professionals and understand the journey from college to civil services.
The programme began with the inauguration of the session by Dr. Neha Anand, Assistant Director-Academics. The event was followed by the traditional lamp lighting ceremony and a warm welcome to the guests with bouquets.
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
Apply for Admission
Apply for Admission
Samrjeet Mishra, Chief Operating Officer at Vajiram & Ravi and a reputed faculty member of Indian Polity, addressed the students. He guided them on competitive examination preparation and explained important aspects of the Indian administrative system. His session helped students understand the importance of focused preparation and awareness of current issues.
Students Learned About Civil Services Preparation

“From Campus to Civil Services: Your Roadmap to Success.”
Kundu had secured All India Rank 27 in UPSC CSE 2025 and IPS All India Rank 288 in UPSC CSE 2024.

Faculty members and students from several TMU colleges, including the College of Agriculture, Management College, Paramedical College, and Law College, participated in the programme. The event was coordinated by Dr. Neha Anand.
Dr. Varun Kumar Singh, Pradeep Verma, Dr. Sakshi, and others also contributed to the successful organisation of the programme.

The 21st Leadership Talk Series-cum-Seminar at TMU provided students with valuable guidance on Civil Services Preparation and career planning. The session helped them understand the importance of clear goals, disciplined preparation, leadership, and continuous self-development. The programme concluded with a vote of thanks by Dr. M.P. Singh, Dean Student Welfare, followed by the presentation of mementoes to the guests and the National Anthem.

Complete Guide to B.Tech Course: Eligibility, Duration, and Career Options
17-09-2026
Engineering
Written by TMU Editorial Team
Table of Contents
A Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) is a four-year professional undergraduate engineering programme designed to equip students with industry-ready technical skills, analytical thinking, and practical problem-solving abilities. Structured across eight semesters, the programme integrates classroom learning with laboratory work, live projects, internships, and research-oriented training.
In today’s technology-driven economy, a B.Tech degree serves as the foundation for careers in software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, manufacturing, infrastructure development, renewable energy, and emerging technologies. Graduates are prepared not only for employment but also for innovation, entrepreneurship, and higher education.
B.Tech Course Overview
Particulars
Details
Course Name
B.Tech (Bachelor of Technology)
Level
Undergraduate
Duration
4 Years (8 Semesters)
Eligibility
10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM), minimum 50% aggregate
Admission Process
Entrance Exam / Merit-Based / Direct Admission (as per university norms)
Accepted Entrance Exams
JEE Main, JEE Advanced, UPSEE, WBJEE, MHT CET, University-Level Entrance Exams
Specialisations Offered
Computer Science Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
Teaching Methodology
Classroom lectures, laboratory practicals, industry-oriented projects, internships
Internship Requirement
Mandatory summer internship / industrial training
Assessment Pattern
Internal assessments, end-semester examinations, project evaluation
Project Work
Minor project (pre-final year), Major capstone project (final year)
Career Pathways
Industry roles, higher studies (M.Tech / MBA / MS), entrepreneurship
B.Tech Course Specialisations
Stream / Branch
Focus Area

Software development, AI, ML, Data Science, Cybersecurity

Aircraft Design, Space Systems, Propulsion
Teerthanker Mahaveer University

BTech Eligibility Criteria
To be eligible for admission to a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) programme, candidates must fulfil the following academic and admission-related requirements:
Completion of Class 12 (or equivalent) with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) from a recognised board
Minimum aggregate of 50% marks in PCM (relaxation applicable for reserved categories as per government and university norms)
Qualification in a recognised entrance examination such as JEE Main, state-level Common Entrance Tests (CETs), or university-specific entrance exams
Diploma holders in engineering are eligible to apply for lateral entry admission directly into the second year of the B.Tech programme
Some private and deemed universities also offer direct admission based on Class 12 merit, subject to institutional guidelines
B.Tech Subjects
B.Tech (Bachelor of Technology) curriculum varies significantly by specialisation. Here is a well-structured list of B.Tec subjects:

Chemical Engineering
Chemical Reaction Engineering, Process Dynamics & Control, Mass Transfer, Heat Transfer, Industrial Safety
Biotechnology
Genetic Engineering, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Bioinformatics
BTech Admission Process
The admission process for Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) programmes in India generally follows a structured, multi-stage procedure to ensure merit-based and transparent selection:
Application Form Submission:
Candidates apply through national examination portals such as JEE Main, state-level counselling authorities, or directly via university admission portals
Entrance Examination:
Applicants appear for recognised entrance tests, including JEE Main, state-level CETs, or university-specific entrance examinations
Counselling & Seat Allotment:
Seats are allocated based on entrance exam rank, choice preferences, reservation norms, and seat availability
Document Verification:
Verification of academic records, entrance exam scorecards, category certificates (if applicable), and valid identity proof
Fee Payment & Enrolment:
Final confirmation of admission is completed upon payment of the prescribed course fees and institutional enrolment

What Skills Do B.Tech Subjects Develop?
The B.Tech curriculum is structured to develop a comprehensive skill set that aligns academic knowledge with real-world engineering applications. Through a balanced combination of theory, practice, and project-based learning, students acquire the following competencies:
Technical Proficiency:
In-depth understanding of core engineering subjects, tools, and technologies relevant to the chosen specialisation
Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills:
Application of mathematics, simulations, modelling, and logical reasoning to analyse and solve complex engineering problems
Practical Exposure:
Hands-on experience through laboratories, workshops, industrial training, and internships to bridge theory with practice
Innovation and Research Aptitude:
Development of creative thinking, experimentation, and research capabilities through electives, minor projects, and final-year capstone projects
Who Should Choose B.Tech?
A B.Tech programme is well-suited for students who possess a technical mindset and aspire to build careers in engineering, technology, and innovation-driven domains.
Strong Academic Foundation:
Students with a solid understanding of mathematics and science subjects
Problem-Solving Orientation:
Individuals who enjoy analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and tackling technical challenges
Industry Aspirations:
Candidates aiming to work in technology-driven sectors such as engineering, IT, manufacturing, and infrastructure
Innovation & Research Focus:
Learners interested in innovation, applied research, product development, or entrepreneurial ventures
Conclusion
The most demanded undergraduate degree program is a B.Tech course because it provides specific technical knowledge, problem-solving skills and practice in the shape of laboratories, projects and internships. Having studied this course, students receive diverse opportunities in different fields such as information technology, manufacturing, artificial intelligence, and data science. The B.Tech course provides numerous employment opportunities to students who would like to work in the technology sector. B.Tech graduates tend to receive better pay.
FAQ
Q1. Which is the best B.Tech course to pursue?
Ans.
There’s no particular best B. Tech course to pursue, it depends on your choice, interest and career goal. Whether you want to pursue your career in Civil Engineering, Electronics Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
Q2. What is the B.Tech course?
Ans.
A B.Tech course (Bachelor of Technology) is a four-year undergraduate degree program. The course is designed to prepare students for a career in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, and Electrical Engineering.
Q3. Can I do a B.Tech course
after 12th?
Ans.
Yes, you can do a B.Tech course after 12th. The core subjects should be Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.
Q4. Is the B.Tech course
3 years or 4 years?
Ans.
B.Tech (Bachelor of Technology) is typically a four-year undergraduate degree program. The program is divided into eight semesters.

BBA in Business Analytics Course: Eligibility, Fees, Admission and Scope
15-09-2026
Business and Management
Written by TMU Editorial Team
Table of Contents
A BBA in Business Analytics
is a 3-year undergraduate management course that
combines business, management, data analysis and technology
. It teaches students how to use data to understand business performance, identify trends, solve problems and support better decision-making.
After completing a BBA in Business Analytics, graduates can pursue roles such as Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Marketing Analyst, and Operations Analyst. It is a suitable option for students interested in both business management and data-driven decision-making.
Understanding BBA in Business Analytics
BBA stands for Bachelor of Business Administration.
It is a 3-year undergraduate course that teaches students about
business management, administration, and decision-making
. When
Business Analytics
is added to BBA, students also learn how to use
data and analytical tools to understand business problems and make better decisions
.
In simple words, a
BBA in Business Analytics combines business management with
data analytics
. Students learn how to study data, identify trends, understand customer behaviour, and help businesses improve their performance.
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
Apply for Admission
Apply for Admission
BBA in Business Analytics Course Overview
Course Name:
BBA in Business Analytics
Course Level:
Undergraduate
Duration:
3 years
Mode:
Full-time / Online, depending on the university
Core Areas:
Business Management, Data Analytics, Statistics, and Decision-Making
Key Subjects:
Business Analytics, Data Visualisation, Statistics, Financial Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Predictive Analytics
Tools & Technologies:
Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and basic programming
Skills Developed:
Data interpretation, problem-solving, analytical thinking, business decision-making, and data visualisation
Career Options:
Business Analyst, Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Marketing Analyst, Operations Analyst, and Financial Analyst
Career Scope:
Suitable for students interested in combining
business management with data-driven analysis
.
Who Can Apply for the Course?
Students who meet the following requirements can generally apply:
Students who have
completed Class 12 (10+2)
from a recognised board.
Students from
any stream—Commerce, Science, or Arts
can apply, depending on the university.
Students should have an
interest in business, numbers, data, and technology
.
Some universities may require
Mathematics or Computer Science
as a subject in Class 12.
Students may need to meet the university's
minimum percentage requirement
.
Admission may be based on
Class 12 marks, an entrance exam, or merit
, depending on the university.
What is the Curriculum of BBA in Business Analytics?
The
BBA in Business Analytics curriculum
combines business management concepts with data analysis and technology. It helps students understand how to collect, analyse, visualise, and use data for business decision-making. The curriculum generally includes:
Key subjects
Business Economics
Financial Management
Marketing Management
Business Statistics
Business Analytics
Data Management and Database Systems
Data Visualisation
Business Intelligence
Predictive Analytics
Excel, SQL and Data Analytics Tools
Python or basic programming
Business Research Methods
Project Work / Internship

Top 9 BBA Specialisations and Their Career Paths
What is the Admission Process for BBA in Business Analytics?
Fill the Application Form:
Apply through the university's official website or
admission portal
.
Submit Documents:
Provide required documents such as Class 10 and 12 marksheets, ID proof, photographs, and other required certificates.
Entrance Exam (If Applicable):
Some universities may conduct an entrance test for admission.
Merit/Selection:

Counselling/Interview:

Fee Payment:
After selection, pay the required admission fee to confirm your seat.
Admission Confirmation:
Complete the remaining formalities and begin the course.
Entrance Exams Accepted
While many universities offer direct admissions based on 10+2 marks, some prestigious institutes conduct entrance exams. These exams test a candidate’s reasoning, analytical, and verbal skills. Some of the commonly accepted entrance exams include:
CUET
(Common University Entrance Test)
NPAT (Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies)
IPMAT (Integrated Program in Management Aptitude Test)
UGAT (Undergraduate Aptitude Test)
SET (Symbiosis Entrance Test)

Online

Online

Online/Offline
Each of these tests usually takes place between April and June every year, and early preparation is key to securing a seat in a top institution.
Direct Admission vs. Merit-Based
Many private colleges and some autonomous universities offer direct admission if the student has secured the minimum required percentage in 10+2. This is especially common in:
Private universities with self-financed seats
Management quota admissions
Online programs
On the other hand, merit-based admissions are strictly dependent on performance in either 10+2 board exams or entrance exams. Top government and central universities often follow this route to ensure fair competition and transparency.

.

.

.

can improve career opportunities.

BBA vs BCom: Which is Better?, Salary, and Job Opportunities

Business and Management
Written by TMU Editorial Team
Table of Contents
Choosing the right undergraduate course after Class 12 can shape your career direction. BBA and BCom are two popular options for students interested in business, finance, management and commerce. But which one is better: BBA or BCom?
The answer depends on your interests and career goals. BBA is more focused on business management, marketing, human resources and entrepreneurship, while BCom gives stronger exposure to accounting, taxation, finance and commerce.
If you are planning to pursue an
MBA
or build a career in management, BBA can be a suitable choice. If you are interested in accounting, finance, taxation, banking or professional courses such as CA, BCom may be more suitable.

What is BBA (Bachelor of Business Administration)?
A Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) is a career-oriented undergraduate management degree designed to prepare students for business leadership, managerial roles, and entrepreneurial careers. The programme focuses on how organisations operate, grow, and compete in real-world markets.
Unlike theory-heavy commerce degrees, BBA places strong emphasis on decision-making, strategic thinking, teamwork, and industry exposure, making it suitable for students aiming for early employability or management roles after graduation.
Students generally study areas such as:
Principles of Management
Marketing Management
Human Resource Management
Business Economics
Financial Management
Business Communication
Business Statistics
Operations Management
Entrepreneurship
Organisational Behaviour
What is BCom (Bachelor of Commerce)?
Bachelor of Commerce
(BCom) is an academically rigorous undergraduate degree that focuses on accounting, finance, economics, taxation, and business law. The programme builds a strong foundation in financial systems and commercial operations, making it ideal for analytically inclined students.
BCom is particularly well-suited for students planning to pursue professional qualifications such as CA, CMA, CS, CFA, or postgraduate degrees in finance, economics, or accounting.
Common BCom subjects include:
Financial Accounting
Corporate Accounting
Business Economics
Business Law
Cost Accounting
Income Tax
Auditing
Corporate Finance
Business Mathematics
Statistics
Marketing
BBA vs BCom: Syllabus Comparison
Although there is some overlap between the two courses, their academic focus is different.

For example,
a BBA student may learn how to develop a marketing strategy, manage employees and understand business operations. A BCom student may spend more time understanding financial statements, taxation, accounting and corporate finance.

Commerce Courses after 12th: Career Options, Salary & Scope
BBA vs BCom: Which Degree Should Commerce Students Choose After Class 12?
There is no single answer to “Is BBA better than BCom?” Both degrees can lead to good career opportunities.
Choose BBA if you want to:
Work in management
Build a career in marketing or sales
Work in human resources
Learn about business operations
Develop leadership and communication skills
Start your own business
Pursue an MBA after graduation
Choose BCom if you want to:
Build a career in accounting
Work in finance or taxation
Prepare for CA, CMA or CS
Work in banking and financial services
Learn about corporate accounting
Develop expertise in commerce and financial management
Pursue MCom or an MBA
In simple terms, BBA is generally more management-oriented, while BCom is more commerce and accounting-oriented.
BBA vs BCom: Which degree is More Versatile?
BBA is more versatile.
BBA (
Bachelor of Business Administration
): Focuses on overall business management. You learn about many parts of a business.
BCom (Bachelor of Commerce): Focuses on finance, accounting, and economics. It's more specific.
Here's why:
Broader Focus:
BBA covers a wider range of business functions, including marketing, human resources, operations, and finance. This broader knowledge base makes BBA graduates more adaptable to different roles and industries.
Entrepreneurial Orientation:
BBA often emphasises entrepreneurial skills and business start-ups, providing a foundation for those looking to venture into their own businesses.
Diverse Career Paths:
The versatility of BBA allows graduates to explore various career options beyond traditional business roles.
BBA vs BCom: Final Verdict
BBA and BCom are both valuable undergraduate degrees, but they are designed with different academic and career orientations.
Choose
BBA
if you are interested in management, marketing, HR, entrepreneurship, business operations or an MBA.
Choose
BCom
if you are more interested in accounting, finance, taxation, auditing, banking or professional commerce qualifications.
Instead of asking
“Which degree is better?”
, ask
“Which degree is better for my career goal?”
Your college, internships, practical skills, certifications and work experience can significantly influence your career after graduation. Therefore, compare the
curriculum, faculty, internships, placement opportunities, specialisations and overall learning environment
before making your decision.
FAQ
Q1. Who gets paid more, BCom or BBA?
Ans.
BBA graduates may earn slightly more in management, sales, marketing, and business roles. However, salary depends on skills, experience, job role, and specialisation.
Q2. Is BBA tougher than BCom?
Ans.
Neither course is necessarily tougher. BBA focuses more on management, marketing, HR, and business operations, while BCom focuses more on accounting, taxation, finance, and commerce.
Q3. Is BBA still in demand?
Ans.
Yes, BBA is still in demand as businesses need graduates for roles in management, marketing, sales, finance, HR, and operations.
Q4. Which BBA specialisation has a high salary?
Ans.
BBA specialisations such as Finance, Business Analytics, Digital Marketing, International Business, and Human Resource Management can offer good salary opportunities.
Q5. What is the average starting salary after BBA?
Ans.
BBA graduates can typically earn around ₹3–5 LPA at the beginning of their careers, depending on their skills, college, location, and job role.
Q6. What is the average starting salary after BCom?
Ans.
BCom graduates can typically earn around ₹2.5–4.5 LPA at the start of their careers, with higher salaries possible with professional qualifications and relevant skills.
Q7. Which is better, BBA or BCom?
Ans.
BBA is suitable for students interested in management and business careers, while BCom is a good choice for students interested in accounting, finance, taxation, and commerce.
Q8. Can I do an MBA after BCom?
Ans.
Yes, BCom graduates can pursue an MBA after completing their bachelor's degree, subject to the eligibility requirements of the institute.
Q9. Can I do an MBA after BBA?
Ans.
Yes, BBA is one of the common undergraduate pathways to an MBA and can provide a foundation in business and management.
Q10. Which has more career options, BBA or BCom?
Ans.
Both offer diverse career options. BBA is commonly aligned with management, marketing, HR, sales, and operations, while BCom offers opportunities in accounting, finance, taxation, banking, and auditing.

Written by TMU Editorial Team
Table of Contents
B Pharmacy (B.Pharm) stands for Bachelor of Pharmacy, an undergraduate degree that focuses on medicines, drugs, their preparation, effects, safety, and proper use. The course is designed for students who wish to build careers in the pharmaceutical industry, hospitals, clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and healthcare management.
With India’s pharmaceutical sector expanding rapidly, B Pharmacy has become one of the most sought-after professional
courses after 12th
science. Students gain both theoretical knowledge and practical exposure through laboratory training, industrial visits, and research-based learning.
B Pharmacy Course Overview
Full Form:
Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm)
Course Level:
Undergraduate degree
Duration:
4 years
Eligibility:
Class 12 with Physics and Chemistry along with Biology or Mathematics
Main Subjects:
Pharmaceutics, Pharmacology, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmacognosy, Biochemistry and Clinical Pharmacy
Course Focus:
Study of medicines, drug development, formulation, testing, safety and their proper use
Admission:
Based on merit or entrance examinations, depending on the university/state
Career Areas:
Pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, clinical research, quality control, drug regulatory affairs and community pharmacies

, Pharm.D, MBA in Healthcare/Pharmaceutical Management and related postgraduate programmes

What are the Eligibility Criteria for B Pharmacy Course?
Students seeking admission to the Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) programme must fulfil the basic academic and admission requirements prescribed by the university and the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).
Candidates must have passed 10+2 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board.
Students should have studied Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects.
Candidates must have Biology or Mathematics as an additional subject in Class 12.
A minimum of 50% aggregate marks is generally required in the qualifying examination.
Reserved category students may receive relaxation in minimum marks as per government norms.
The minimum age for admission is usually 17 years.
Admission may be offered through merit-based selection or entrance examinations.
Some universities accept scores from CUET or state-level pharmacy entrance exams.
B Pharmacy Course Syllabus and Curriculum
The
B.Pharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy)
syllabus is designed to provide students with knowledge of medicines, drug formulation, pharmacology, pharmaceutical chemistry, and healthcare. It is generally a
4-year undergraduate course divided into 8 semesters
. The curriculum combines
theory, laboratory practicals, industrial training, and project work
.

FAQ
Q1. What is B.Pharm salary in India?

Q2. Is B.Pharm easier than MBBS?
Ans.
B.Pharm and MBBS are different professional courses, so their difficulty depends on the student's interests and strengths. MBBS involves extensive study of human anatomy, diseases, diagnosis, and clinical treatment, while B.Pharm focuses mainly on medicines, drug development, pharmacology, and pharmaceutical sciences.
Q3. Is B.Pharm equal to a doctor?
Ans.
No. B.Pharm is not equivalent to an MBBS degree, and B.Pharm graduates are not medical doctors. Pharmacists are healthcare professionals who are trained in medicines, their preparation, safety, dosage, and proper use. They do not diagnose diseases or perform medical treatment like doctors.
Q4. Who earns more, B.Pharm or BPT?
Ans.
The salary of B.Pharm and BPT graduates varies depending on experience, job role, location, and employer. Generally, B.Pharm graduates may have a wider range of opportunities in pharmaceutical companies, while BPT graduates mainly work in physiotherapy and rehabilitation. Both can earn well with experience and specialisation.
Q5. Can I get B.Pharm without NEET?
Ans.
Yes. NEET is generally not required for admission to B.Pharm in India. Admission may be based on Class 12 marks, university-level admission criteria, or state/college entrance examinations. However, eligibility and admission rules can vary between institutions.
Q6. What can I do after B Pharmacy?
Ans.
After B.Pharm, graduates can work in pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, pharmacies, clinical research, quality control, regulatory affairs, production, and drug safety. They can also pursue higher studies such as M.Pharm or an MBA.

A
D. Pharm course is
a two-year diploma programme designed to prepare students for careers in the pharmaceutical industry, community pharmacy, or hospital-based practice. This course serves as an entry-level qualification for individuals aspiring to become registered pharmacists in India. The duration of the D.Pharm course is 2 years, followed by a 3-month compulsory internship or practical training.
To be eligible, candidates must have
completed 10+2
with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology or Mathematics from a recognised board. Admission is typically based on merit, though in some states or institutions, D. Pharmacy entrance exams such as state-level CETs (e.g., JEECUP for Uttar Pradesh) are conducted to shortlist candidates.
What is the Full Form of D. Pharma?
D Pharma stands for
Diploma in Pharmacy
.
The "D" in D Pharma represents "Diploma," indicating that the qualification is at the diploma level. The term "Pharma" refers to the pharmaceutical field, which encompasses the study and practice of pharmacy.

FAQ
Q1. Is D.Pharm better or B.Pharm?
Ans.
D.Pharm is suitable for students who want to start a pharmacy career in a shorter time, while B. Pharm offers broader career opportunities and better options for higher studies.
Q2. What is the scope of D.Pharm course?
Ans.
D.Pharm course graduates can work as registered pharmacists in hospitals, retail pharmacies, community pharmacies and pharmaceutical companies. They can also pursue B.Pharm for further career growth.
Q3. Is NEET compulsory for D.Pharm course?
Ans.
No, NEET is generally not compulsory for D.Pharm admission. Students usually need to complete 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or Biology, subject to the admission rules of the institution or state.
Q4. What is the highest salary in D.Pharm?
Ans.
There is no fixed highest salary after D.Pharm course. Earnings depend on experience, job role, employer and location. Experienced professionals in hospitals or pharmaceutical companies can earn higher salaries.
Q5. Can I join a D. Pharm course without any entrance exam?
Ans.
Yes, some colleges offer D. Pharm admission based on eligibility and merit without a common entrance exam. However, admission requirements can vary between colleges and states.
Q6. Which job is best after the D.Pharm course?
Ans.
Working as a registered pharmacist, hospital pharmacist or pharmaceutical company employee are some of the popular career options after a D.Pharm course. The best choice depends on your skills and career goals.
Q7. Which job is highest paid in pharmacy?
Ans.
Senior roles in pharmaceutical management, regulatory affairs, clinical research, drug safety and quality management can offer higher salaries, especially with advanced qualifications and experience.

Pharm D Course: Full Form, Eligibility, Fees, Admission and Scope
14-09-2026
Pharmacy
Written by TMU Editorial Team
Table of Contents
The
PharmD course
stands for
Doctor of Pharmacy
and is a professional doctoral-level programme focused on the study of medicines, their safe use, patient care, clinical pharmacy, and drug therapy. The course combines classroom learning with practical training in areas such as pharmacology, pharmaceutics, clinical pharmacy, pharmacotherapeutics, and hospital pharmacy.
Students learn how medicines work, how they should be used, and how pharmacists support doctors and patients in healthcare. The PharmD course also includes clinical training and internship experience, preparing graduates for careers in hospitals, clinical pharmacy, pharmaceutical companies, drug safety, and other healthcare sectors.
Read More:
Diploma in Pharmacy programme
PharmD Course – Key Highlights
Full Form:
Doctor of Pharmacy
Course Duration:
6 years, including clinical training/internship
Eligibility:
10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Biology/Mathematics
Course Focus:
Clinical pharmacy, medicines, pharmacotherapy and patient care
Practical Training:
Includes hospital-based clinical training and internship
Career Options:
Clinical Pharmacist, Hospital Pharmacist, Drug Safety Associate, Medical Writer, Researcher
Work Areas:
Hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, research centres, clinical trials and healthcare organisations
Higher Studies:
Students can pursue advanced studies and specialisations
Teerthanker Mahaveer University
Apply for Admission
Apply for Admission
Who Can Apply for the PharmD Course?
Students can apply for the PharmD course if they meet the following eligibility requirements:
Completed Class 12 from a recognised board.
Studied Physics and Chemistry as compulsory subjects.
Studied Biology or Mathematics as an additional subject.
Candidates with a Diploma in Pharmacy (D Pharm) may also be eligible, depending on the admission rules.
B Pharm
graduates can apply for the PharmD (Post Baccalaureate) programme.
Candidates must meet the age and admission requirements of the respective university.
Syllabus and Curriculum of Pharm D Programme
The
PharmD curriculum
focuses on medicines, clinical pharmacy, patient care, and the practical application of pharmaceutical knowledge. In India, the regular PharmD is generally a
6-year programme
, including
5 years of academic study and 1 year of internship or residency training
.

How to Get Admission to PharmD?
To get admission to the PharmD course, students generally need to:

– Select a recognised institution offering PharmD.

– Apply online or offline through the
institution's admission portal
.
Submit Documents
– Provide Class 10 and 12 certificates, ID proof, photographs, and other required documents.

– Admission may be based on merit or an entrance examination, depending on the institution.

– Participate in counselling if applicable and confirm your allotted seat.
Pay Fees & Confirm Admission
– Pay the prescribed admission fee and complete the remaining formalities.
What is the Scope of PharmD?
In 2026, the PharmD course has good career scope in
hospitals, clinical pharmacy, pharmaceutical companies, research, pharmacovigilance, clinical research, drug safety, regulatory affairs, and medical writing
. PharmD graduates can work closely with healthcare teams to support safe and effective use of medicines.

Conclusion
The PharmD course is a career-focused programme that combines pharmaceutical knowledge with clinical and patient-care skills. It offers opportunities in hospitals, clinical pharmacy, pharmacovigilance, research, pharmaceutical companies, and other healthcare fields. With the growing need for medication experts and patient-centred care, PharmD can provide good career opportunities in India and abroad.
FAQ
Q1. What is the highest salary for PharmD?
Ans.
A PharmD graduate can earn a high salary in clinical pharmacy, medical writing, pharmacovigilance, research, or management. In India, experienced professionals may earn ₹10–20 lakh or more per year, depending on their role, skills, and experience.
Q2. Is PharmD course more difficult than MBBS?
Ans.
PharmD courses and
MBBS
are both demanding, but their focus is different. MBBS covers diagnosis and treatment of diseases, while PharmD focuses mainly on medicines, clinical pharmacy, and patient care. The difficulty depends on your interests and strengths.
Q3. Can I do a PharmD course after B Pharm?
Ans.
Yes. In India, B Pharm graduates can generally pursue a PharmD course (Post Baccalaureate), which is typically a three-year programme, subject to the applicable admission rules.
Q4. Which is better, a PharmD course or M Pharm?
Ans.
PharmD is more clinically oriented and focuses on patient care and medicines. M Pharm is usually more specialised in areas such as pharmaceutics, pharmacology, or pharmaceutical chemistry. The better option depends on your career goal.
Q5. What is the future of pharmacy?
Ans.
Pharmacy has opportunities in clinical pharmacy, pharmaceutical companies, research, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, drug safety, and healthcare services.
Q6. Does PharmD have scope abroad?
Ans.
Yes. PharmD course can offer opportunities abroad, but pharmacists usually need to meet the destination country's licensing, registration, examination, and language requirements..
Q7. Which state is best for pharmacy in India?
Ans.
States such as Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, and Uttar Pradesh have strong pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors, creating various opportunities for pharmacy graduates.

Teerthanker Mahaveer Dental College & Research
Centre: Among the Top Dental Colleges in India.
Teerthanker Mahaveer Dental College & Research
Centre:
Among the Top Dental Colleges in India.
Teerthanker Mahaveer Dental College and Research Centre,
established in 2005, is one of the most prestigious and accredited dental colleges. The
college is actively involved in high-quality teaching and research in oral health care,
making it a centre of excellence for providing world-class education.
Choosing the right dental college is crucial for aspiring
dentists. Teerthanker Mahaveer Dental College and Research Centre (TMDC&RC) stands out
as one of the premier colleges in India. With a focus on academic excellence, practical
knowledge, and global career opportunities, TMU Dental College offers a holistic
educational experience that prepares students for a successful dental career.
Read More
Key Highlights
Curriculum
Infrastructure
Key Highlights
TMDC&RC offers extensive dental education specialising in all 9 fields of dentistry. These
include:
Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics
Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery
Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics
Prosthodontics and Crown & Bridge
Paedodontics & Preventive Dentistry
Periodontology
Public Health Dentistry
Oral Medicine & Radiology
Oral Pathology & Microbiology
Additionally, we have a basic sciences department for the overall exposure of
the students.
Read More
Placement/Internship
TMDC&RC excels in providing outstanding internships and placements, which play a vital role in
every dentist's career journey. A decent number of our students are working in dental clinics
across India, the South Asia Pacific, and the Middle East.
We also go beyond boundaries by conducting student exchange programmes that enable our dental
students to gain global exposure and experience in dentistry. Our alumni have achieved
remarkable success in various sectors. It includes dental clinics, government and private
hospitals, educational institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research institutes, dental
equipment manufacturers, and dental product manufacturers.
Curriculum
Experience excellence in the dental profession at TMDC&RC, where innovation and practical
training take centre stage. Our commitment extends to fostering exceptional skills across
clinical, academic, and research domains, creating a conducive learning environment for students
to achieve their career goals. Our programmes adhere to international standards and meet the
Dental Council of India's regulations.
With case-based and futuristic integrated e-learning, we equip students to tackle various
oro-dental diseases. Through dental camps, outreach programmes, and community service,
students gain invaluable practical experience. We encourage young researchers to publish
papers and participate in national and international seminars, symposiums, conferences, and
workshops, keeping them updated with the latest advancements in dental science.
Beyond academics, we offer diverse extracurricular activities, sports, and cultural events,
nurturing talents and fostering overall development.
Read More
Infrastructure
The dental college has ultra-advanced clinical facilities and a majestic infrastructure. Equipped
with modern X-ray apparatus and advanced technology, including cone beam computed tomography,
orthopantomography, and surgical bone saw, our students gain hands-on experience with
cutting-edge tools.
Our simulated pre-clinical and research laboratories offer a conducive learning environment.
The air-conditioned central library is accessible for 12 hours a day, providing students
with valuable resources. With separate dormitories for girls and boys in a serene
environment, students enjoy round-the-clock comfort and security.
TMDC&RC's major strength lies in the large number of patients visiting the OPD, providing
ample clinical exposure to dental students. The 900+ beds super-speciality clinical setting
attracts both rural and urban populations, offering diverse patient cases to enhance
students' skills. At TMU, we prioritise an enriching and supportive environment to nurture
the growth of our dental students.

College of Pharmacy, Among the Top Colleges for
Pharmacy Courses/Programmes
College of Pharmacy,
Among the Top
Colleges for Pharmacy Courses/Programmes
The College of Pharmacy was established in the year 2008 and
approved by the Pharmacy Council of India. The college grooms professionals by providing
diplomas and graduate, post-graduate and doctorate-level programmes, equipping students with
innovative techniques to solve problems in the pharmaceutical industry and clinical
settings.
Welcome to the College of Pharmacy at Teerthanker Mahaveer
University (TMU), where academic excellence meets practical experience to shape the
future leaders of the pharmaceutical world. Recognised as one of the top colleges for
pharmacy courses in India, the College provides a unique blend of theoretical knowledge
and hands-on training, preparing our students for successful careers in the dynamic
field of pharmacy.
Read More
Key Highlights
Placement/Internship
Curriculum
Infrastructure
Key Highlights
It is a hub for academic research and consultancy, fostering expertise
by offering a wide range of programmes that equip students with the knowledge and skills
needed to excel in the ever-evolving field of pharmacy.
By offering the PharmD programme, the College of Pharmacy demonstrates
its dedication to elevate the standards of pharmacy education and prepare
graduates/post-graduates for advanced roles in the healthcare system as it is only
available in six pharmacy institutions in Uttar Pradesh.
The college takes pride in its fully functional Drug Information Centre,
which is one of its kind in the state of Uttar Pradesh. This centre serves as a valuable
resource and offers an ideal platform for students to enhance their knowledge in
pharmacovigilance and develop skills in drug information retrieval and analysis.
Placement/Internship
The college has a proven track record of successful placements. Our
graduates have secured positions in diverse roles and settings, including community pharmacies,
hospital pharmacies, pharmaceutical companies, research institutions, regulatory agencies, and
academia.
Center for Teaching, Learning & Development (CTLD) provides comprehensive career guidance and
counselling services to our students in the field of innovation and entrepreneurship.
Teerthanker Mahaveer University's Corporate Resource Center is committed to empowering students
on their journey from admission to placement, with a strong focus on achieving an 82% placement
rate. With personalised assistance in resume building, interview preparation, and professional
training, our students are well-equipped to showcase their skills and abilities to potential
employers.
Curriculum
Programmes are approved by the Pharmacy Council of India.
A meticulously designed curriculum with deliberations from top
professionals and academic bodies to nurture an industry-ready employable workforce.
Emphasis on independent thinking, creativity, and innovation.
A highly disciplined and motivated environment with an extensive focus
on practical based learning of our students.
Infrastructure
The College of Pharmacy has well-equipped laboratories for
Pharmaceutics, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Analysis and Pharmaceutical Chemistry as well
as Pharmacognosy and Herbal Medicine with access to sophisticated instruments.
The major equipment available in this college are IR Spectrophotometer,
HPLC, Lyophilizer, Rotary tablet punch, Digital Dissolution apparatus, Brookfield
Rheometer, Nephelometer and Plethysmometer.
The smart classrooms with advanced technology and cutting-edge
facilities enhance the learning experience, enabling instructors to deliver engaging
presentations and interactive sessions.
The college library is a treasure house of pharmaceutical literature and
resources. Students have access to an extensive collection of books, journals, research
papers, and e-resources, enabling them to stay updated with the latest advancements in
the field.

Healthcare Sciences (Paramedical)
was established in the year 2010 to provide
trained, qualified, technical personnel in the field of Paramedical Science to support the
medical profession. The objective of the Paramedical Science programme is to ensure
educational opportunities for developing skills.
This comprehensive programme equips students with the skills
and knowledge required to provide vital support to medical professionals, patients, and
communities. Our curriculum is designed in consultation with healthcare experts,
ensuring students gain relevant skills and knowledge. With an emphasis on evidence-based
practice, research, and innovation, our graduates are well-prepared for emerging trends
and challenges.
